narration: One pan, one square metre of surface. Water three millimetres deep. Clear, still, dry night.
caption: एक तवा, एक वर्ग मीटर सतह। पानी तीन मिलीमीटर गहरा। साफ़, शांत, सूखी रात।
image_brief: A single square metal pan of water standing alone on a straw mat in an open desert yard at night, the water barely covering the base, stars overhead.

narration: Three millimetres across a square metre is three litres. Three litres of water weighs three kilograms.
caption: एक वर्ग मीटर पर तीन मिलीमीटर का मतलब तीन लीटर। तीन लीटर पानी यानी तीन किलो।
image_brief: A glass measuring jug pouring water into a shallow pan that rests on a floor scale, the scale dial pointing at three kilograms, plain workshop light.

narration: Net loss to the sky, eighty watts. Eighty joules of heat leaving every second. Steadily.
caption: आसमान की तरफ़ शुद्ध नुक़सान अस्सी वाट। हर सेकंड अस्सी जूल गर्मी बाहर।
image_brief: A shallow pan of water resting on straw at night with faint wisps of vapour drifting up off the surface into the dark air above it.

narration: Start the water at five degrees. The first job is reaching zero. Just cooling.
caption: पानी पाँच डिग्री से शुरू। पहला काम है शून्य तक पहुँचना। बस ठंडा होना।
image_brief: A glass thermometer standing upright in a shallow pan of water, its red column sitting a little above the zero mark, fading evening light.

narration: Water takes about four thousand two hundred joules to warm one kilogram by one degree.
caption: एक किलो पानी को एक डिग्री गर्म करने में लगभग चार हज़ार दो सौ जूल लगते हैं।
image_brief: A steel pot of water on a low blue gas flame in a dark kitchen, tiny bubbles clinging to the base, a lid resting on the counter beside it.

narration: So three kilograms falling five degrees releases four thousand two hundred, times three, times five.
caption: तो तीन किलो पाँच डिग्री गिरने पर निकलता है चार हज़ार दो सौ, गुना तीन, गुना पाँच।
image_brief: A wooden abacus lying flat on a desk with three beads pushed across one row and five beads separated on the row below, lamplight from one side.

narration: Sixty three thousand joules in total. At eighty a second, that is thirteen minutes. Barely anything.
caption: कुल तिरसठ हज़ार जूल। अस्सी जूल प्रति सेकंड पर यह तेरह मिनट है। कुछ भी नहीं।
image_brief: A wind-up kitchen timer set near the thirteen minute mark standing on a cold stone step beside a shallow pan of water at night.

narration: Thirteen minutes in, the pan sits at zero degrees. And it is still liquid. Completely.
caption: तेरह मिनट बाद तवा शून्य डिग्री पर है। और अब भी पूरा तरल है।
image_brief: A shallow pan at night holding perfectly still clear water with a thermometer propped in it reading zero, no ice anywhere on the surface.

narration: Because water at zero and ice at zero are different things. Freezing costs extra energy.
caption: क्योंकि शून्य का पानी और शून्य की बर्फ़ अलग चीज़ें हैं। जमने की क़ीमत अलग है।
image_brief: A glass bowl split down the middle by a thin metal divider, clear water on one side and crushed ice on the other, on a dark counter.

narration: Turning one kilogram of water into ice releases three hundred thirty four thousand joules. No temperature change at all.
caption: एक किलो पानी को बर्फ़ बनाने में तीन लाख चौंतीस हज़ार जूल निकलते हैं।
image_brief: A large block of clear ice sitting on a wooden pallet in a dim storeroom, meltwater pooling under one corner, loose straw packed around the sides.

narration: Compare four thousand two hundred for one degree. Freezing costs roughly eighty times more. Eighty.
caption: एक डिग्री के चार हज़ार दो सौ से तुलना करो। जमना लगभग अस्सी गुना महँगा है।
image_brief: Two sacks on a warehouse floor, one small and flat and one enormous and bulging, a hand cart parked beside the larger one.

narration: That ratio is why cooling water is easy and freezing it is hard. Remember it.
caption: इसी अनुपात से पानी ठंडा करना आसान है और जमाना सचमुच मुश्किल। याद रखिए।
image_brief: A gentle stone ramp in the foreground rising into an abruptly steep flight of stone stairs behind it, both in flat daylight.

narration: Three kilograms needs three times that. About one million joules to become ice. One million.
caption: तीन किलो को इसका तीन गुना चाहिए। बर्फ़ बनने के लिए लगभग दस लाख जूल।
image_brief: Three identical shallow pans of water lined up on straw along a long trench at night, thin ice beginning to form on all three surfaces.

narration: One million joules, divided by eighty each second, is twelve thousand five hundred seconds. Do that division.
caption: दस लाख जूल को अस्सी प्रति सेकंड से बाँटो, तो बारह हज़ार पाँच सौ सेकंड।
image_brief: An old brass mechanical counter on a workbench with its digits stopped mid-count, a pencil and a sheet of scribbled figures lying beside it.

narration: Three and a half hours. A winter night offers twelve hours of darkness. Ice by dawn.
caption: साढ़े तीन घंटे। सर्दी की रात बारह घंटे अँधेरा देती है। सुबह तक बर्फ़।
image_brief: A desert trench of pans at first light, a complete plate of ice sitting in every pan, pale sky, long shadows thrown by the enclosure wall.
